message: The aspect '{0}' cannot implement interface '{2}' in the type '{1}' because the aspect member '{3}', marked with the [InterfaceMember] attribute, does not have the same type or return type as the corresponding interface member '{4}'.
title: An aspect member marked with [InterfaceMember] does not have the same type as the interface member.
rationale: The title misses the word 'not' ('does match'). The message says 'implicitly implement', but ImplementInterfaceAdvice.Initialize (TryAddMember, line 140) also reports it for explicit implementations ([InterfaceMember(IsExplicit = true)]), and it says 'return type' although the check also compares the type (and ref kind) of properties and events.
